description: Qwen 3.8 Flash Next Q8_0 by Unsloth
gpu_tip: ~194GB total at 128K context. With 512 experts and only 10 routed + 1 shared active per token, llama.cpp's MoE expert offloading works about as well here as it ever does — a 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4080) carries the always-on layers at full speed while a 256GB DDR5 workstation kit holds the mostly-idle experts.
mac_tip: Needs ~194GB — past a 192GB Mac Studio once macOS takes its share; a 256GB or 512GB M3 Ultra is the realistic option.
